meta.name: Crew Girl
meta.description:
After a family scandal, teen rower Teagan Tao moves to a small town and joins an elite prep school's all-boys crew, sparking rivalry and attraction.

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

videos.title: The Catch
videos.overview: A female rower becomes the coxswain of a dysfunctional all-boys rowing team.

videos.title: The Hateful Eight
videos.overview: Easton's rowing team struggles to find their rhythm ahead of an alumni race as egos clash over the stroke seat. Ella stresses about Teagan's tuition.

videos.title: Flight Crew
videos.overview: Family rivalry heats up between Josh and Ryder during a first-class birthday celebration. Cam guides Teagan in her bid to earn the team's trust.

videos.title: True Rowmance
videos.overview: As the team gears up for its first away race, Teagan grapples with competing interests off the water. Brittany floats a tempting proposition.

videos.title: Anatomy of a Fall Formal
videos.overview: Teagan's grand entrance at Easton's fall formal turns heads — and hearts. But the night gets choppy when unexpected emotions threaten to spoil the fun.

videos.title: Bad Break
videos.overview: After a suspicious setback during a key race against Westvale, Noah's mystery-themed after-party becomes a real-life investigation in the boathouse.

videos.title: Under Pressure
videos.overview: Competing under scout scrutiny at the indoor qualifiers, Easton's top rowers grapple with secret struggles, personal sacrifices and Olympic ambitions.

videos.title: O Coxswain, My Coxswain
videos.overview: Oars at the ready! A pivotal final race on home waters tests the team's integrity and resilience as old mistakes give way to new beginnings.
